content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The COREMERCH solution is an alternative to payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal, which are often unavailable or severely restricted in countries like Zimbabwe. This solution is based on open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOWPayments, which enable creators to collect payments in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and USDT. By using this infrastructure, creators can avoid platform fees and maintain control over their online stores and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH solution is built on a stack of free and paid tools. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages is used for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. This setup enables instant product delivery and automatic payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The COREMERCH solution is designed for digital creators who face payment restrictions in countries like Zimbabwe, Nigeria, Ghana, and others. These creators sell digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, and software, but often struggle with payment processing due to platform shutdowns or restrictions. This solution gives them a sovereign digital commerce stack that they can control and deploy without relying on third-party platforms.
Creators can avoid platform fees by using the COREMERCH solution, retaining up to $921 per month on a $97 product.
